Subject: POC next steps & workload intake — FinTechX

Hi Anita / Raj —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we��we're aligned on scope for the 3-week POC: 

1) Success criteria (what FinTechX will use to evaluate):
   - API latency: median tail < 250ms for 1-2-token responses; p50 < 120ms for typical prompts (~60 tokens).
   - Cost: token cost target ~ $0.002/token equivalent for inference (we'll provide model/quantization tradeoffs).
   - Quality: end-to-end recall/precision on the 500-case regression suite (we'll run the eval).
   - Stability: no more than 1 incident/week affecting >=10% of requests during business hours.

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
   - Week 0 (next week): workload/profile intake + signed MSA addendum for trial infra.
   - Week 1: ingest sample traffic, run compatibility checks (tokenization, max length), and baseline runs.
   - Week 2: parallel runs on live-like traffic, run regression tests + quality eval.
   - Week 3: handoff to your engineering + go/no-go decision.

3) Ownership:
   - Redwood: Ben (sales) - overall coordination; Marissa (solutions) - technical onboarding; Dylan (infra) - capacity/config.
   - FinTechX: Anita - product owner; Raj - infra / traffic owner.

4) Immediate ask (today): please fill in the workload profile below and attach any sample payloads you can share. We need:
   - Average RPS during business hours and peak RPS (examples)
   - Typical request token length (prompt + expected response) and 95th percentile token length
   - Concurrent requests expected (steady-state and burst)
   - Burst duration and frequency (e.g., 30s bursts every hour; 2-3x baseline)
   - Auth model (per-tenant keys, single API key) and data residency constraints

I've attached a starter workbook (poc-success-criteria.xlsx) and a JSON schema for the workload profile (workload-profile.json).

Proposed next step: quick kickoff on Monday Oct 31, 10:00am PT for intake and environment provisioning. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks -
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (Excel, 10KB stub)
Attachment: workload-profile.json (JSON, 3KB stub)

From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@fintechex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC next steps & workload intake — FinTechX

Hi Ben -

Thanks for the clear recap - Monday 10am PT works for us. Below is the initial workload profile; Raj will follow up with sample payloads by EOD today.

- Average RPS (business hours, 9am-6pm PT): 12 rps
- Peak RPS: sustained 90 rps for ~10 minutes; absolute burst up to 250 rps for ~30-60s during reconciliation windows
- Typical token lengths: prompt = 40-80 tokens; expected model response = 20-60 tokens; combined typical = ~100 tokens
- 95th percentile token length: 450 tokens (we have some long-context cases)
- Concurrency: steady-state concurrent requests: 35; planned concurrency during stress windows: 220
- Burst patterns: daily short bursts (30-90s) at 2-3x baseline; weekly end-of-day longer bursts (up to 250 rps)
- Auth: per-tenant API keys; will provide scoped keys for POC
- Data residency: US only; no PHI

We've attached a zip of 200 anonymized sample requests (payloads.zip). Raj - can you confirm the exact cadence for the 250rps reconciliation job and send the payloads?

Regards,
Anita Singh
VP Product - Payments | FinTechX
anita.singh@fintechex.com

Attachment: payloads.zip (zip, 1.2MB stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: POC next steps & workload intake — FinTechX

Thanks Anita - this is perfect and super helpful. A few quick notes / clarifications: 

- The 95th percentile at 450 tokens is noted - Marissa, this suggests we should test with a 512-token config and also run a few 2k token checks for the long-context cases.
- Raj: for the reconciliation job, can you confirm if the 250rps is a single-region load or spread across multiple origins? If single-region, we'll reserve capacity on a single Dedicated pool for that window.
- For the per-tenant keys, we'll create scoped API keys in the POC sandbox and send them via secure DocuSign/1Password share once the MSA addendum is signed.

I'll send the calendar invite for Mon 10am PT. Today Dylan and Marissa will size the initial cluster and provide a short provisioning checklist so you can approve infra.

- Ben
